title.zh: 第二十六 百官三 宗正 大司農 少府
title.raw: 第二十六 百官三 宗正 大司農 少府 Volume 116: Officials Part Three

sentences.zh: 志第二十六 百官三

translations.literal: Treatise twenty-six: Officials, part three.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 26: The Bureaucracy, Part Three.

sentences.zh: 宗正 大司农 少府

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Clan; Minister of Finance; Privy Treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Clan, the Minister of Finance, and the Privy Treasurer.

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Clan: one minister, salary of two thousand piculs at the middle grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Clan was a single ministerial post, ranked at two thousand piculs at the middle rate.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌序录王国嫡庶之次及诸宗室亲属远近，郡国岁因计上宗室名籍。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is charged with ordering and recording the sequence of legitimate and secondary heirs in royal kingdoms and the degrees of kinship among all members of the imperial house; each year the commanderies and kingdoms, through the annual accounting, submit registers of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: The office kept the order of succession for legitimate and secondary sons in princely kingdoms and recorded how closely imperial clansmen were related; each year commanderies and kingdoms filed clan registers with the capital as part of the annual accounts.

sentences.zh: 若有犯法当髡以上，先上诸宗正，宗正以闻，乃报决。

translations.literal: If any commit offenses punishable by shaving the head or above, it is first reported to the Director of the Imperial Clan; the Director reports and receives instructions, and only then is sentence returned and decided.
translations.idiomatic: For crimes carrying punishment of shaving the head or worse, the case had to go to the Director of the Imperial Clan first; he reported to the throne, and judgment followed only after imperial approval.

translations.literal: One assistant director, salary comparable to one thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant director, ranked at the thousand-picul level.

sentences.zh: 诸公主，每主家令一人，六百石。

translations.literal: For the various princesses, each princess has one household steward, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Each imperial princess had one steward of her household, at six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: One assistant, three hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant steward, at three hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：其余属吏增减无常。

translations.literal: Original note says: As for the remaining subordinate clerks, increases and decreases were not fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The rest of the subordinate staff varied over time without a fixed establishment.

translations.literal: Those on the right belong to the Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: The offices listed above were under the Director of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：中兴省都司空令、丞。

translations.literal: Original note says: At the restoration, the metropolitan superintendent of works and his assistant were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After the restoration of the Han, the metropolitan superintendent of works and his deputy were cut.

sentences.zh: 大司农，卿一人，中二千石。

translations.literal: Minister of Finance: one minister, salary of two thousand piculs at the middle grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Finance was a single ministerial post, ranked at two thousand piculs at the middle rate.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌诸钱谷金帛诸货币。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is charged with all cash, grain, gold, silk, and the various currencies.
translations.idiomatic: He oversaw state revenue in coin and grain, precious metals, silk, and other forms of money.

sentences.zh: 郡国四时上月旦见钱谷簿，其逋未毕，各具别之。

translations.literal: The commanderies and kingdoms each season submit, on the first of the month, ledgers of current cash and grain; where arrears are not yet cleared, each is separately itemized.
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies and kingdoms filed monthly ledgers of cash and grain on the calends; any outstanding arrears were listed separately.

sentences.zh: 边郡诸官请调度者，皆为报给，损多益寡，取相给足。

translations.literal: When border commandery officials request allocations, all are reported and supplied, reducing where there is surplus and adding where there is shortage, so as to achieve mutual sufficiency.
translations.idiomatic: Border posts that asked for supplies received them through his office, which shifted surplus to cover shortfalls until needs were met.

translations.literal: One assistant minister, salary comparable to one thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: He had one assistant minister, at the thousand-picul level.

translations.literal: One bureau assistant, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: There was one bureau assistant at six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: The bureau assistant is in charge of the treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau assistant managed the state treasuries.

translations.literal: One director of the great granary, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the great capital granary held rank at six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：主受郡国传漕谷。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of receiving grain transported by water from the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: He received grain shipped by canal and river tribute from the commanderies and kingdoms.

translations.literal: One assistant.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant.

translations.literal: One director of the balancing standard, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the market-stabilization office was ranked at six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌知物贾，主练染，作采色。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is charged with knowing the prices of goods; he is in charge of boiling and dyeing silk and producing colors.
translations.idiomatic: He monitored commodity prices and oversaw the boiling, dyeing, and coloring of textiles.

translations.literal: One assistant.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant.

translations.literal: One director of the milling office, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the imperial milling office held rank at six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：主舂御米及作乾糒。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of hulling rice for the imperial table and making dried rations.
translations.idiomatic: He milled rice for the palace kitchens and prepared dried provisions for travel and campaigns.

translations.literal: "Xun" means to select.
translations.idiomatic: The word xun here means "to select" or "to choose."

translations.literal: One assistant.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant.

translations.literal: Those on the right belong to the Minister of Finance.
translations.idiomatic: The foregoing offices were subordinate to the Minister of Finance.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：郡国盐官、铁官本属司农，中兴皆属郡县。

translations.literal: Original note says: The salt and iron offices of the commanderies and kingdoms originally belonged to the Minister of Finance; at the restoration they all belonged to the commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Salt and iron monopolies had once reported to the Minister of Finance; after the restoration they were devolved to local commandery and county government.

sentences.zh: 又有廪牺令，六百石，掌祭祀牺牲雁鹜之属。

translations.literal: There was also a director of granaries and sacrificial animals, six hundred piculs, in charge of sacrificial victims, geese, ducks, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a director of granaries and sacrificial livestock at six hundred piculs, responsible for temple victims, waterfowl, and related offerings.

sentences.zh: 及雒阳市长、荥阳敖仓官，中兴皆属河南尹。

translations.literal: As for the market chief of Luoyang and the Aocang granary official of Xingyang, at the restoration they all belonged to the governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The Luoyang market superintendent and the keeper of the Aocang granary at Xingyang were transferred after the restoration to the governor of Henan.

translations.literal: The remainder, such as equal transport, were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Offices like the equal-distribution transport system were eliminated.

translations.literal: Privy Treasurer: one minister, salary of two thousand piculs at the middle grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Privy Treasurer was a single ministerial post at two thousand piculs, middle rate.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌中服御诸物，衣服宝货珍膳之属。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is charged with all things used within for clothing and conveyance—garments, treasures, goods, rare foods, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: He supplied the inner court with clothing, equipage, valuables, and fine foods for the imperial table.

translations.literal: One assistant minister, salary comparable to one thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: He had one assistant minister at the thousand-picul level.

translations.literal: One director of imperial physicians, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the imperial medical corps held rank at six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of the various physicians.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised all court physicians.

translations.literal: One assistant for drugs and one assistant for formulas, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: There were two assistants: one for materia medica and one for prescriptions.

translations.literal: Original note says: The drug assistant is in charge of drugs.
translations.idiomatic: The materia medica assistant managed the drug stores.

translations.literal: The formula assistant is in charge of medical formulas.
translations.idiomatic: The formula assistant kept the prescription archives.

translations.literal: One director of the grand provisioner, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The grand provisioner, who ran the imperial kitchens, was ranked at six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of the imperial diet.
translations.idiomatic: He was responsible for food and drink at court.

sentences.zh: 左丞、甘丞、汤官丞、果丞各一人。

translations.literal: Left assistant, sweet assistant, soup-house assistant, and fruit assistant, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: There were four specialized assistants: for the left kitchen, sweets, the liquor office, and fruit.

translations.literal: Original note says: The left assistant is in charge of drink and food.
translations.idiomatic: The left assistant oversaw general catering.

translations.literal: The sweet assistant is in charge of feast utensils.
translations.idiomatic: The sweets assistant managed confectionery and table equipage.

translations.literal: The soup-house assistant is in charge of ale.
translations.idiomatic: The liquor-office assistant handled wine and brewing.

translations.literal: The fruit assistant is in charge of fruit.
translations.idiomatic: The fruit assistant supplied fresh and preserved fruit.

translations.literal: One director of the chamberlain of the palace seal, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the palace stationery and sealing office held six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：主御纸笔墨及尚书财用诸物及封泥。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of imperial paper, ink, brushes, and the various goods and sealing clay for the Secretariat's expenses.
translations.idiomatic: He supplied the palace with paper, ink, brushes, stationery for the Secretariat, and sealing wax.

translations.literal: One assistant.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant.

translations.literal: One director of the Shanglin Park, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The superintendent of the Shanglin imperial park was ranked at six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of the beasts and birds within the park.
translations.idiomatic: He managed game and fowl inside the park.

translations.literal: There are rather many commoners' dwellings; he is in charge of them all.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners also lived inside the enclosure, and he had authority over them as well.

translations.literal: When they capture and obtain its beasts, they send them to the grand provisioner.
translations.idiomatic: Game taken in the hunt was delivered to the imperial kitchens.

translations.literal: One assistant and one commandant, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: The office had one assistant and one park warden.

translations.literal: Gentlemen-in-attendance, salary comparable to two thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Gentlemen-in-attendance were ranked at the two-thousand-picul level.

translations.literal: Original note says: There is no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: There was no fixed number of posts.

sentences.zh: 掌侍左右，赞导众事，顾问应对。

translations.literal: They are charged with attending to the left and right, assisting and guiding the multitude of affairs, and responding to inquiries and questions.
translations.idiomatic: They attended the emperor, steered court business, and answered his questions on the spot.

sentences.zh: 法驾出，则多识者一人参乘，余皆骑在乘舆车后。

translations.literal: When the regulated chariot train goes out, then one of great knowledge rides as guard in the secondary seat; the rest all ride on horseback behind the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On formal processions the most senior gentleman-in-attendance rode in the escort seat beside the emperor; the others followed the carriage on horseback.

sentences.zh: 本有仆射一人，中兴转为祭酒，或置或否。

translations.literal: Originally there was one supervisor; at the restoration it was changed to libationer, sometimes established, sometimes not.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly there had been a chief supervisor; after the restoration the title became libationer, an office that was sometimes filled and sometimes left vacant.

translations.literal: Regular palace attendants, one thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Regular palace attendants were initially ranked at one thousand piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs; there is no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: They were eunuchs, and their number was not fixed.

translations.literal: Later their rank was increased to be comparable to two thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Later their salary was raised to the two-thousand-picul level.

sentences.zh: 掌侍左右，从入内宫，赞导内众事，顾问应对给事。

translations.literal: They are charged with attending to the left and right, following and entering the inner palace, assisting and guiding the multitude of inner affairs, responding to inquiries and questions, and handling business.
translations.idiomatic: They stayed at the emperor's side, followed him into the inner palace, managed inner-court business, answered his questions, and carried out his orders.

translations.literal: Gentlemen of the Yellow Gates, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Gentlemen attendants at the Yellow Gate were ranked at six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: There is no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: There was no fixed quota of posts.

sentences.zh: 掌侍从左右，给事中，关通中外。

translations.literal: They are charged with attending and following to the left and right, serving within the court, and linking the inner and outer.
translations.idiomatic: They attended the sovereign, held "serving within" status, and carried messages between the palace and the ministries.

sentences.zh: 及诸王朝见于殿上，引王就坐。

translations.literal: And when the various kings have audience in the hall, they lead the king to his seat.
translations.idiomatic: When kings were received in the main hall, they escorted each prince to his place.

translations.literal: Junior attendants at the Yellow Gate, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Yellow Gate attendants held rank at six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs; there is no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: They were eunuchs without a fixed establishment.

translations.literal: They are charged with attending to the left and right and receiving Secretariat business.
translations.idiomatic: They waited on the emperor and took charge of paperwork from the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 上在内宫，关通中外及中宫已下众事。

translations.literal: When the sovereign is in the inner palace, they link the inner and outer and all affairs from the empress's palace downward.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor stayed in the inner quarters, they relayed orders between the harem, the ministries, and everyone from the empress down.

sentences.zh: 诸公主及王太妃等有疾苦，则使问之。

translations.literal: If the various princesses and royal consorts and the like have illness or suffering, then they are sent to inquire.
translations.idiomatic: They were dispatched to inquire after princesses, princes' mothers, and other royal women who fell ill.

translations.literal: One director of the Yellow Gates, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the Yellow Gate eunuchs held six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: The post was held by a eunuch.

translations.literal: He is in charge of the various eunuchs within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded the eunuch staff inside the palace compound.

translations.literal: One assistant and one following assistant, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: He had one deputy and one assistant for escort duty.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: These deputies were also eunuchs.

translations.literal: The following assistant is in charge of going out and entering and following.
translations.idiomatic: The escort deputy managed attendants who accompanied the emperor in and out.

sentences.zh: 黄门署长、画室署长、玉堂署长各一人。

translations.literal: One chief of the Yellow Gate compound, one chief of the painting chamber, and one chief of the Jade Hall, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: There was one chief warden each for the Yellow Gate compound, the painting studio, and the Jade Hall.

translations.literal: Seven chiefs of the Bing compound.
translations.idiomatic: Seven chiefs supervised the Bing-side compounds.

translations.literal: All are four hundred piculs, yellow ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: All held rank at four hundred piculs with the yellow ribbon of office.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: These posts were reserved for eunuchs.

translations.literal: Each is in charge of a separate place in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Each warden had charge of a distinct quarter inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 中黄门冗从仆射一人，六百石。

translations.literal: One supervisor of supernumerary followers among attendants at the Yellow Gates Within, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The chief of the supernumerary inner Yellow Gate escorts held six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: The office was held by a eunuch.

translations.literal: He is in charge of the supernumerary followers among attendants at the Yellow Gates Within.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded the extra inner Yellow Gate attendants attached to the train.

translations.literal: When at rest, then night guard, standing duty guarding gates and doors;
translations.idiomatic: In the capital they stood night watch and guarded gates and doors;

translations.literal: when going out, then riding as followers, flanking the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: on the road they rode in escort, flanking the imperial chariot.

translations.literal: Attendants at the Yellow Gates Within, salary comparable to one hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Yellow Gate attendants began at the hundred-picul rate.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs; there is no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: They were eunuchs, and their numbers were not fixed.

translations.literal: Later it was increased to be comparable to three hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Later the rank was raised to three hundred piculs.

translations.literal: They are charged with handling affairs within the forbidden precincts.
translations.idiomatic: They performed miscellaneous duties inside the sealed palace.

translations.literal: One director of the lateral courts, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the Yeeting women's quarters held six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: The director was a eunuch.

translations.literal: He is in charge of the affairs of the honorable ladies and selected women of the rear palace.
translations.idiomatic: He administered the imperial concubines and palace maids of the harem.

translations.literal: Left and right assistants and one assistant of the harsh chamber, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: There were left and right assistants plus one deputy for the "harsh chamber" infirmary.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: These assistants were eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 暴室丞主中妇人疾病者，就此室治；

translations.literal: The assistant of the harsh chamber is in charge of women within who have illness; they come to this chamber for treatment;
translations.idiomatic: The harsh-chamber deputy looked after ailing palace women, who were brought there for care;

sentences.zh: 其皇后、贵人有罪，亦就此室。

translations.literal: If the empress and honorable ladies have offenses, they also come to this chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The empress and honored consorts who were found guilty were likewise held in that chamber.

translations.literal: One director of the Everlasting Lane, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The warden of the Everlasting Lane held rank at six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: The office was held by a eunuch.

translations.literal: He is in charge of official slave girls who wait and serve.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised the palace bondmaids who waited on the inner court.

translations.literal: One assistant.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: That assistant was also a eunuch.

translations.literal: One director of the imperial wardrobe treasury, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the imperial wardrobe office held six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: The director was a eunuch.

sentences.zh: 典官婢作中衣服及补浣之属。

translations.literal: He is in charge of official slave girls making inner clothing and patching and washing and the like.
translations.idiomatic: He oversaw palace women who sewed inner garments, mended, and laundered linens for the palace.

translations.literal: One assistant and one assistant of the weaving chamber, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: There were one deputy director and one deputy for the weaving chamber.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Both posts were filled by eunuchs.

translations.literal: One director of minor sacrifices, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of minor palace sacrifices held six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge within of the various small sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He arranged the smaller rituals performed inside the palace.

translations.literal: One assistant.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant was a eunuch.

translations.literal: One director of the hook-shield office, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The superintendent of the Goudu palace parks held six hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: The post was reserved for a eunuch.

sentences.zh: 典诸近池苑囿游观之处。

translations.literal: He is in charge of the various places near pools, parks, and preserves for roaming and viewing.
translations.idiomatic: He managed the ponds, hunting parks, and pleasure grounds near the capital.

sentences.zh: 丞、永安丞各一人，三百石。

translations.literal: One assistant and one assistant of perpetual peace, each three hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: There were a chief deputy and a Yong'an compound deputy, each at three hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Both deputies were eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 永安，北宫东北别小宫名，有园观。

translations.literal: Perpetual peace is the name of a separate small palace northeast of the Northern Palace; it has gardens and belvederes.
translations.idiomatic: Yong'an was a detached lodge northeast of the Northern Palace, with its own gardens and viewing towers.

sentences.zh: 苑中丞、果丞、鸿池丞、南园丞各一人，二百石。

translations.literal: One assistant within the park, one fruit assistant, one Hong Pool assistant, and one Southern Park assistant, each two hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: There were deputies for the inner park, the orchards, Hong Pool, and the Southern Park, each at two hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：苑中丞主苑中离官。

translations.literal: Original note says: The assistant within the park is in charge of detached palaces within the park.
translations.idiomatic: The inner-park deputy managed the lodges built inside the imperial preserves.

translations.literal: The fruit assistant is in charge of fruit orchards.
translations.idiomatic: The fruit deputy oversaw the palace orchards.

sentences.zh: 鸿池，池名，在雒阳东二十里。

translations.literal: Hong Pool is the name of a pool, twenty li east of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Pool was a sheet of water twenty li east of Luoyang.

translations.literal: The Southern Park is south of the Luo River.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Park lay on the south bank of the Luo.

sentences.zh: 濯龙监、直里监各一人，四百石。

translations.literal: One overseer of Zhuolong and one overseer of Zhili, each four hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuolong Park and Zhili each had a steward at four hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：濯龙亦园名，近北宫。

translations.literal: Original note says: Zhuolong is also the name of a park, near the Northern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuolong was another park name, close to the Northern Palace.

sentences.zh: 直里亦园名也，在雒阳城西南角。

translations.literal: Zhili is also the name of a park, at the southwest corner of the Luoyang city wall.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili was likewise a pleasure ground at the southwest corner of Luoyang.

translations.literal: One director of the inner treasury, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the inner treasury held six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌中幣帛金银諸貨物。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge within of silks, coins, gold, silver, and the various goods.
translations.idiomatic: He stored silk, currency, gold, silver, and other valuables for the inner court.

translations.literal: One assistant.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant.

translations.literal: One director of the inner service, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the inner furnishers held six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌宫中布張諸衣物。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge within the palace of cloth hangings and the various garments.
translations.idiomatic: He supplied draperies, hangings, and clothing used inside the palace.

translations.literal: One left assistant and one right assistant, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: There were left and right assistants.

translations.literal: One director of the imperial workshops, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the imperial workshops held six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌上手工作御刀劍諸好器物。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of superior handicraft work, imperial knives, swords, and the various fine vessels.
translations.idiomatic: He oversaw master craftsmen who forged the emperor's blades and other fine metalwork.

translations.literal: One assistant.
translations.idiomatic: There was one assistant.

translations.literal: One director of the masters of writing, one thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the Secretariat held rank at one thousand piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：承秦所置，武帝用宦者，更为中书谒者令，成帝用士人，复故。

translations.literal: Original note says: Inherited from what Qin established; Emperor Wu used eunuchs and changed it to director of palace secretaries and ushers; Emperor Cheng used literati and restored the old.
translations.idiomatic: The office dated to Qin; Emperor Wu had put eunuchs in charge under the title of palace secretary and usher; Emperor Cheng returned it to civil officials under the old name.

sentences.zh: 掌凡选署及奏下尚书曹文书众事。

translations.literal: He is in charge of all selections and appointments and of memorializing and issuing downward the documents and multitude of affairs of the masters-of-writing bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: He handled appointments, routed memorials, and dispatched paperwork to the six secretariat bureaus.

translations.literal: One supervisor of the masters of writing, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat supervisor held six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：署尚书事，令不在则奏下众事。

translations.literal: Original note says: He signs off on masters-of-writing business; when the director is absent, he memorializes and issues downward the multitude of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He acted for the director of the Secretariat and, in the director's absence, cleared memorials and orders for the whole board.

translations.literal: Six masters of writing, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: There were six secretariat ministers at six hundred piculs each.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：成帝初署尚书四人，分为四曹：常侍曹尚书主公卿事，二千石曹尚书主郡国二千石事，民曹尚书主凡吏上书事，客曹尚书主外国夷狄事。

translations.literal: Original note says: At the beginning of Emperor Cheng's reign four masters of writing were appointed, divided into four bureaus: the regular-attendant bureau master of writing was in charge of affairs of dukes and ministers; the two-thousand-picul bureau master of writing was in charge of affairs of two-thousand-picul officials of commanderies and kingdoms; the people bureau master of writing was in charge of affairs of all clerks submitting memorials; the guest bureau master of writing was in charge of affairs of foreign states and barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Cheng had first set four bureau chiefs: one for nobles and ministers, one for commandery and kingdom officials at two thousand piculs, one for commoners' petitions, and one for foreign envoys and frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 世祖承遵，后分二千石曹，又分客曹为南主客曹、北主客曹，凡六曹。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangwu inherited and followed; later the two-thousand-picul bureau was split, and the guest bureau was further split into south guest bureau and north guest bureau; in all six bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangwu kept that structure, then split the two-thousand-picul bureau and divided the guest bureau into southern and northern guest affairs, for six bureaus in all.

translations.literal: One left assistant and one right assistant, each four hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right assistants of the board each held four hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: They are in charge of recording documents and scheduled meetings.
translations.idiomatic: They kept the files and tracked deadlines for the six bureaus.

sentences.zh: 左丞主吏民章报及驺伯史。

translations.literal: The left assistant is in charge of clerks' and commoners' memorial replies and of outriders and chief clerks.
translations.idiomatic: The left assistant handled petitions from officials and commoners and supervised the board's runners and senior clerks.

sentences.zh: 右丞假署印绶及纸笔墨诸财用库藏。

translations.literal: The right assistant temporarily assigns seals and ribbons and paper, ink, brush, and the various goods and treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: The right assistant issued seals and ribbons on temporary authority and managed stationery and supply vaults.

translations.literal: Thirty-six gentleman attendants, four hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-six secretariat gentlemen attendants served at four hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：一曹有六人，主作文书起草。

translations.literal: Original note says: Each bureau has six persons; they are in charge of drafting documents.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the six bureaus had six of them to draft outgoing paperwork.

translations.literal: Eighteen clerks, two hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen secretariat clerks held rank at two hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: Each bureau has three; they are in charge of writing.
translations.idiomatic: Each bureau had three clerks to manage correspondence.

sentences.zh: 后增剧曹三人，合二十一人。

translations.literal: Later three were added for the urgent bureau, in all twenty-one.
translations.idiomatic: Three more were later added for the urgent-affairs desk, making twenty-one in total.

translations.literal: One director of tallies and seals, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The director of tallies and seals held six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：为符节台率，主符节事。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is the chief of the tally-and-seal terrace; he is in charge of tally-and-seal affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He headed the tally office and controlled all credentials and seals of office.

translations.literal: Whenever envoys are dispatched, he is in charge of handing over the staff of authority.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the court sent an envoy, his office issued the imperial baton of authority.

translations.literal: Four gentlemen of the interior in charge of tallies and seals.
translations.idiomatic: Four court gentlemen supervised the imperial seal and tally chest.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：旧二人在中，主玺及虎符、竹符之半者。

translations.literal: Original note says: Formerly two persons were within, in charge of the seal and of tiger tallies and bamboo tallies of the half type.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly two men inside the palace had guarded the imperial seal and the split tiger and bamboo tallies.

translations.literal: Clerk of the tally and seal office, two hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The tally office had clerks at two hundred piculs.

translations.literal: Original note says: In charge of writing.
translations.idiomatic: They kept the tally office's written records.

translations.literal: One assistant to the imperial counselor, one thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial counselor's deputy in the palace held one thousand piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：御史大夫之丞也。

translations.literal: Original note says: He is the assistant of the imperial counselor.
translations.idiomatic: He was formally the deputy to the imperial counselor.

sentences.zh: 旧别监御史在殿中，密举非法。

translations.literal: Formerly separately supervising censors were in the hall, secretly reporting what was unlawful.
translations.idiomatic: Palace censors had once watched the court in secret and denounced irregularities.

sentences.zh: 及御史大夫转为司空，因别留中，为御史台率，后又属少府。

translations.literal: When the imperial counselor was changed to minister of works, therefore separately he remained within and became chief of the censorate; afterward he again belonged to the Privy Treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: When the counselor's post became minister of works, the censor-in-chief stayed inside as head of the censorate and later was placed under the Privy Treasurer.

sentences.zh: 治书侍御史二人，六百石。

translations.literal: Two attending censors for document review, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Two legal specialists among the attending censors held six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌选明法律者为之。

translations.literal: Original note says: In charge of selecting those clear on the laws to fill the posts.
translations.idiomatic: Only men expert in statute law were chosen for these posts.

sentences.zh: 凡天下诸谳疑事，掌以法律当其是非。

translations.literal: As for doubtful cases of deliberation throughout the realm, they are in charge of applying the law to match right and wrong.
translations.idiomatic: They ruled on doubtful appeals from the empire by applying the code.

translations.literal: Fifteen attending censors, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen attending censors served at six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌察举非法，受公卿群吏奏事，有违失举劾之。

translations.literal: Original note says: They are in charge of investigating and reporting what is unlawful, receiving memorials on affairs from dukes, ministers, and the host of clerks; if there are violations or errors, they report and impeach.
translations.idiomatic: They policed misconduct, took memorials from the high nobility and bureaucracy, and impeached wrongdoing.

sentences.zh: 凡郊庙之祠及大朝会、大封拜，则二人监威仪，有违失则劾奏。

translations.literal: As for suburban and temple sacrifices and great court assemblies and great enfeoffments and appointments, then two persons supervise deportment; if there are violations or errors, they impeach and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: At great sacrifices, audiences, and investitures, two of them watched ritual deportment and filed impeachments over any lapse.

translations.literal: Orchid Terrace clerks, six hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Orchid Terrace secretariat clerks held six hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：掌奏及印工文书。

translations.literal: Original note says: They are in charge of memorials and of seal craftsmen documents.
translations.idiomatic: They handled memorials to the throne and the seal-engravers' paperwork.

translations.literal: Those on the right belong to the Privy Treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: The offices listed above fell under the Privy Treasurer.

sentences.zh: 本注曰：职属少府者，自太医、上林凡四官。

translations.literal: Original note says: As for offices whose duties belong to the Privy Treasurer, from the grand physician and Shanglin, in all four offices.
translations.idiomatic: Only four bureaus still drew their substantive duties directly from the Privy Treasurer, beginning with the grand physician and Shanglin.

sentences.zh: 自侍中至御史，皆以文属焉。

translations.literal: From gentlemen-in-attendance down to censors, all are attached to him by document.
translations.idiomatic: From gentlemen-in-attendance through the censorate, they were administratively attached to his ministry.

sentences.zh: 承秦，凡山泽陂池之税，名曰禁钱，属少府。

translations.literal: Inherited from Qin, as for taxes on mountains, marshes, dikes, and pools, the name is forbidden money; they belonged to the Privy Treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: Since Qin, revenue from royal forests, lakes, and ponds had been called "forbidden cash" and went to the Privy Treasurer.

sentences.zh: 世祖改属司农，考工转属太仆，都水属郡国。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangwu changed them to belong to the Minister of Finance; the works of artificers was transferred to belong to the grand coachman; capital waterworks belonged to commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangwu reassigned that income to the Minister of Finance, moved the directorate of works to the grand coachman, and devolved water conservancy to local government.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝初置水衡都尉，秩比二千石，别主上林苑有离官燕休之处，世祖省之，并其职于少府。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu at first established the chief commandant of waters and balances, rank comparable to two thousand piculs, separately in charge of Shanglin Park having detached palaces and places for feasting and rest; Emperor Guangwu abolished it and merged its duties into the Privy Treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu had created the water-and-balances commandant at two thousand piculs to run Shanglin's lodges and resorts; Emperor Guangwu abolished the post and folded its duties back into the Privy Treasurer.

sentences.zh: 每立秋貙刘之日，辄暂置水衡都尉，事讫乃罢之。

translations.literal: Each time on the day of autumn's beginning of the chu and liu hunt, then temporarily the chief commandant of waters and balances is established; when the affair is finished, then it is abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Each autumn, for the imperial hunt, the water-and-balances commandant was revived briefly and then disbanded when the rite ended.

translations.literal: The Privy Treasurer originally had six assistants; five were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Privy Treasurer once had six assistants; five were cut.

translations.literal: Further the soup-house director and weaving-chamber director were abolished, and assistants were established.
translations.idiomatic: The liquor-office and weaving-chamber directors were dropped in favor of deputies only.

sentences.zh: 又省上林十池监，胞人长丞，宦者、昆台、佽飞三令，二十一丞。

translations.literal: Further abolished were ten pool overseers of Shanglin, the chief and assistant of the placenta attendants, three directors of eunuchs, Kun Terrace, and flying archers, and twenty-one assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Also struck were ten Shanglin pond stewards, the chief and deputy for the palace birth-attendant corps, three eunuch-led directorates including Kun Terrace and the flying-archer guard, and twenty-one assistant posts.

sentences.zh: 又省水衡属官令、长、丞、尉二十余人。

translations.literal: Further more than twenty directors, chiefs, assistants, and commandants belonging to the water-and-balances subordinates were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Over twenty more ranks under the old water-and-balances establishment were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 章和以下，中官稍广，加尝药、太官、御者、钩盾、尚方、考工、别作监，皆六百石，宦者为之，转为兼副，或省，故录本官。

translations.literal: From the Zhanghe reign downward, inner officials gradually expanded; added were overseers of tasting medicine, grand provisioner, charioteers, hook-shield, imperial workshops, works of artificers, and separate works—all six hundred piculs, eunuchs holding them, changed to concurrent deputies, or abolished; therefore the original offices are recorded.
translations.idiomatic: After the Zhanghe era the eunuch establishment grew: stewards over tasting, kitchens, equipage, parks, workshops, and separate ateliers at six hundred piculs, often held concurrently or later cut—hence this note preserves their original titles.
